li.title: The First Subjects
li.text: They arrive in small groups, drawn by rumor and desperation. Refugees from the ashlands, skaa with nowhere else to go. They look at you and see power. They do not understand what you are - not yet. But they kneel, because the alternative is the wasteland at their backs. You accept their service. An empire requires subjects. These will be the first of many.

li.title: The Noble Houses
li.text: Order requires hierarchy. You select the most capable among your followers and elevate them. They will be your nobility - granted privilege, granted authority, granted the Allomantic bloodlines you will cultivate through careful breeding. The rest will serve. It is not cruelty. It is architecture. A thousand years is a long time, and you have learned that people need structure more than they need freedom. The beads of Lerasium are distributed. The noble houses of the Final Empire take their first breath.

li.title: The Steel Ministry
li.text: Faith is a tool. You know this better than anyone - you killed the man the prophecies spoke of and took his place. Now you codify the lie into doctrine. The Steel Ministry will be your church, your bureaucracy, your eyes and ears. The obligators will track bloodlines, enforce contracts, and ensure that Allomantic power remains where you direct it. The Inquisitors - your most terrible creation - will enforce silence on any who question. The religion of the Survivor will never arise if there is nothing to survive against. Or so you believe.

li.title: Whispers of Rebellion
li.text: The skaa grow restless. Whispers pass through the underground - talk of freedom, of rights, of the world before the ash. You have heard these whispers before, a hundred times over the centuries. They always fade. The obligators root out the agitators. The Inquisitors make examples. But this time something feels different. The whispers carry a name you do not recognize, and the skaa speak it with something you have not seen in their eyes for a very long time: hope.

li.title: The Survivor of Hathsin
li.text: A Mistborn. A full Mistborn, risen from the skaa - from the Pits of Hathsin, of all places. He fights with iron and steel, with pewter and tin, and he smiles while he does it. The reports are alarming not for the damage he causes, but for what he represents. You have spent a millennium ensuring that no skaa Mistborn could exist. Yet here he stands. Kelsier, they call him. The Survivor. He has assembled a crew, and he is coming for your empire. You have crushed a thousand rebellions. But none of them were led by a man who had already died once and refused to stay dead.
